campbell.title: Campbell City Council — September 15, 2026
campbell.summary: The Campbell City Council considered updates to the city's theater use policy, a cost-share agreement with the City of San Jose for resurfacing work, and the annual update to the city's investment policy for fiscal year 2026-27. Council also considered a budget adjustment to fund replacement of remaining equipment, though details on that item were limited.
keyTopics: Proposed modifications to Council Policy Section 14 (Theater Use Policy), effective September 16
Cost-share agreement with the City of San Jose, not to exceed $335,000, for resurfacing work
Annual update to the city's investment policy for fiscal year 2026-27
Budget adjustment to fund replacement of remaining equipment

saratoga.title: Saratoga City Council — September 16, 2026
saratoga.summary: The Saratoga City Council took up routine business along with two land-use appeals and final map approvals for property subdivisions. It also considered appeals of Planning Commission decisions on housing projects at 6th Street and Oak Place, and discussed options for law enforcement services ahead of upcoming town hall meetings.
keyTopics: Appeal of Design Review and setback variance approval for a house and ADU at 14650 6th Street
Appeal of Tentative Map and Design Review approval for a three-lot subdivision at 14486 Oak Place
Final map approvals for lot splits at 20517 Carniel Avenue and 19351 Saratoga Los Gatos Road
Discussion of law enforcement service options ahead of September 19 and 30 town hall meetings
Resolution amending the City's Conflict of Interest Code

los-altos.title: Los Altos City Council — September 22, 2026
los-altos.summary: The Los Altos City Council considered a wastewater treatment plant agreement with Palo Alto and Mountain View, a continued VTA Board appointment for a councilmember, and appointments to several city commissions. The Council also took up an interim urgency ordinance establishing a temporary moratorium related to detention or custodial facilities, along with a legal services contract amendment and routine meeting minutes approval.
keyTopics: Addendum No. 14 to the Regional Water Quality Control Plant agreement with Palo Alto and Mountain View
Jonathan D. Weinberg's continued appointment to the VTA Board representing north counties
Interim urgency ordinance on a temporary moratorium for detention or custodial facilities and processing facilities
Appointments to the Complete Streets, Environmental, and Planning Commissions
Amendment to the legal services agreement with Berliner Cohen, LLP, updating retainer and hourly rates

los-gatos.title: Los Gatos Town Council — September 15, 2026
los-gatos.summary: The Los Gatos Town Council considered routine administrative items at this meeting, including approval of minutes from prior closed and open session meetings and the monthly financial and investment report for July 2026. The Council also considered several contract actions, including amendments to existing agreements and new professional services agreements.
keyTopics: Approval of minutes from the September 1, 2026 Town Council meetings (closed and open session)
Monthly Financial and Investment Report for July 2026
A second amendment to an existing agreement
A first amendment to an agreement for heating, ventilation, and air conditioning services
New professional services agreements for the Town

san-jose.body: Rules and Open Government Committee and Committee of the Whole
san-jose.title: San José Rules and Open Government Committee and Committee of the Whole — September 30, 2026
san-jose.summary: The Sept. 30 agenda for the Rules and Open Government Committee covered finalizing the Oct. 6 Council agenda and canceling the Oct. 13 meeting. It also listed special event approvals, a committee work plan update, and policy proposals on council transparency, non-disclosure agreements, and rules for automated license plate reader data.
keyTopics: Review and finalization of the October 6, 2026 Council agenda, including possible new items and time-certain scheduling
Special event approvals: Councilmember Mulcahy's 'Conversations for Good 2026' event, the District 9 farewell celebration, and retroactive approval of the Golden State Valkyries flag raising
Proposals on Council transparency and use of private non-disclosure agreements
Two related proposals on internal controls and data access safeguards for Automated License Plate Readers
Update to the Public Safety, Finance and Strategic Support Committee's August–December 2026 work plan

mountain-view.title: Mountain View Council Sustainability Committee — September 29, 2026
mountain-view.summary: The Council Sustainability Committee reviewed a draft Five-Year Community Decarbonization Plan outlining strategies to reduce greenhouse gas emissions across Mountain View, along with the city's 2024 community greenhouse gas emissions inventory. The meeting also included time for public comments and committee discussion.
keyTopics: Draft Five-Year Community Decarbonization Plan
2024 Community Greenhouse Gas Emissions Inventory

sunnyvale.title: Sunnyvale City Council — September 29, 2026
sunnyvale.summary: The Sunnyvale City Council considered a five-year plan for addressing homelessness in the community, along with several contracts for city services including recreation software, video conferencing equipment, and a maintenance management system. The meeting also included recognitions for Filipino American History Month, Hindu American Heritage Month, and Domestic Violence Awareness Month.
keyTopics: Adoption of the Sunnyvale Homelessness Response Plan as a five-year framework, with a community outreach update
Contract awards for City Hall video conferencing/traffic management upgrades, UPS system upgrades, and a 10-year computerized maintenance management system with OpenGov
Amendment to extend and expand the Active Network recreation management software agreement by nine years and $574,978
Reimbursement agreement with VTA for relocating city water facilities for the US 101 Express Lanes project, plus a $300,000 budget modification
Side letter agreement with the Public Safety Officers Association adding special pay for a new Community Crime Reduction Team

cupertino.title: Cupertino City Council — September 29, 2026
cupertino.summary: The Cupertino City Council met in closed session to conduct a performance evaluation of the City Manager, as allowed under state open-meeting law for personnel matters. The public agenda otherwise consisted of standard legal notices about lobbying rules, deadlines for challenging City decisions, and accessibility accommodations.
keyTopics: Closed-session performance evaluation of the City Manager

santa-clara.title: Santa Clara City Council — September 22, 2026
santa-clara.summary: The Santa Clara City Council considered a major housing proposal to prezone and annex land at 451-475 El Camino Real, allowing a 408-unit residential development along with related on- and off-site improvements. The Council also reviewed an Environmental Impact Report prepared for the project under state environmental law, and met in closed session to discuss ongoing legal matters.
keyTopics: Prezone, general plan pre-designation, and annexation application for 451-475 El Camino Real to allow 408 new residential units
Vesting Tentative Subdivision Map for the El Camino Real housing development
Review of an Environmental Impact Report (EIR) prepared under CEQA for the project
Closed-session discussion of existing litigation involving Silicon Valley Power and the California Department of Water Resources
Closed-session discussion of anticipated litigation (one potential case)

milpitas.title: Milpitas City Council — September 15, 2026
milpitas.summary: The Milpitas City Council reviewed plans for federal Community Development Block Grant funding, got updates on the city's red light camera program and the condition of the Milpitas Community Center, and handled financial business tied to the former Redevelopment Agency, including a bond refunding resolution. The council also reviewed its upcoming meeting calendar.
keyTopics: Draft Program Year 2025 Community Development Block Grant Consolidated plan
Presentation on the Red Light Camera Traffic Safety Program
Presentation on the condition of the Milpitas Community Center
Resolution for the Successor Agency to the Redevelopment Agency, including sale and issuance of refunding bonds
Review of the City Council calendar of meetings

palo-alto.title: Palo Alto Parks and Recreation Commission — September 22, 2026
palo-alto.summary: The Palo Alto Parks and Recreation Commission considered proposed guidelines for using synthetic turf on playgrounds, and reviewed a park improvements ordinance recommendation tied to a project at Foothills Nature Preserve. The meeting also included a council liaison update, a department report, and updates from ad hoc committees.
keyTopics: Proposed Playground Synthetic Turf Use Guidelines
Park Improvements Ordinance recommendation for the Foothills Nature Preserve Improvement Project (PE-21000)
Department staff report
Ad hoc committee and liaison updates
Council liaison report
